verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile's own page says Agent Tasks are now in the app as a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks, where you can start new tasks and track their progress on the go. A screenshot shows the agent task list. You can also assign issues to Copilot and then refine, approve and merge the resulting PR from your phone. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing copy (e.g., viewing session logs, stopping or steering a running task, completion notifications), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile agent-task experience.
